question: Does native dual inventory Display produce layer-dependent binocular disparity with a complete zero-depth equality control?
claim: Same-frame raw inventory eyes are byte identical at depth 0. At depths 25 and 100, tab and footer regions shift differently from the inventory grid; stable xr-sim captures show both eye-specific panels. This confirms bounded binocular layer separation, not headset quality or full-path acceptance.
method: Running Steam Prey with process-scoped xr-sim and xr-tape 0.1.0. Captured native D3D11 RGBA pairs at depth 25, 0 and 100; checked headers, exact zero equality and region horizontal shifts with Python 3.12, NumPy 1.26.4 and Pillow. See docs/INVENTORY-STEREO-LIVE-2026-09-13.md. Supplements 20260913-inventory-stereo-matrix.

identity.reason: Tested DLL hash in preserved launch manifest; Steam module identity matches verified supported target.

instrument.reason: Validated 48-byte headers, matched native frame IDs and dimensions; nonempty visible inventory in both eyes. Raw pair and compositor sources retained.

control.reason: Zero-depth complete RGBA pair byte identical; nonzero depth yields nonuniform region disparity with strength response.

scene.reason: Loaded Talos Lobby, selected Disruptor inventory. Native Back key517 opens PDA; observed close and stable reopen.

restore.reason: Disabled stereo and inventory capture, VR teardown logged, then terminated exact owned PID34272 and verified absence. Process-scoped runtime setup.

baseline.reason: Bounded pixel controls pass, but one black fallback compositor frame after synchronous readback is unresolved. Not approval of the complete VR path. Build and 39 tests pass separately.

limits: No headset acceptance, full 6DoF UI reprojection, controller drag or broad Display replay validation. Integer disparity estimates are region-level. Recorder truncated at 20000 frames, quads generic type36; later eye coverage is from xr-sim snapshots. Black frame may be freshness expiry during readback; timing cause not proven. One later context-reference release correction builds/tests but was not live tested.
